sara (partnerships): FYI — marketplace vendors were pinged about the SDK auth header change. Need to align on scope for edge hardware partners too. 
ben (sdk): Thanks. Do we have a concrete list of breaking fields? I can draft a compatibility shim if we need it.
ashley (hw-partner-rel): @sara most SI/hw partners run pinned stacks, some on older linux images. They asked for a 3-month runway.
ben (sdk): Ok. Here's the minimal breaking set I care about: `auth_header` rename -> `x-rdinfer-auth`, removal of legacy `batch_size` int field, and new `meta.tags` object.
jordan (platform): For Private customers we can enable a feature-flag to accept both headers for 12 weeks. Could route via the compat proxy.
sara (partnerships): 3-month runway + compat proxy sounds right. Let's map to dates: announcement week of 1746000000, canary 2 weeks later, enforcement 12 weeks after that.
ashley (hw-partner-rel): Will tell partners to opt into canary in their staging cycles. A couple of SI teams want a side-by-side shim rather than proxy changes.
ben (sdk): I can cut a shim library (npm + pypi) — suggestion: `@redwood/compat-shim` with a single opt-in flag. Quick pseudo-install:
```
# node
npm install @redwood/compat-shim
require('@redwood/compat-shim').enable({acceptLegacyAuth: true})
```

ben (sdk): That handles header translation + `batch_size` fallback. Will also emit a deprecation warning once per process.
infra-bot: deploy-job #sdk-shim-build triggered by ben — build passed in 6:12.
jordan (platform): We need a marketplace note about the private deployment check — add a checklist: OS image, kernel >=5.10, openssl >=1.1.1, and shim test results.
sara (partnerships): I'll prepare partner comms. Can each of you add a one-liner for the partner note by EOD? Example: "We will support both auth headers for 12 weeks; enable shim for older clients"
ashley (hw-partner-rel): Adding now.
ben (sdk): Added. PR link: https://git.redwood/integrations/compat-shim/pull/42 :thumbsup:
jordan (platform): I'll add the deployment checklist to the marketplace listing draft.
sara (partnerships): Awesome. Quick risk callout: if any SI refuses the shim we should offer migration support (paid eng time). Noted for finance.
ben (sdk): Also logging: we'll include an opt-in telemetry flag so we can measure legacy header usage. No payloads.
ashley (hw-partner-rel): Partners asked about rolling back the deprecation if issues show up — agree on a pause-and-extend policy.
jordan (platform): Policy: pause at any stage if >5% error spike or any security regression report.
sara (partnerships): Great. I'll send the partner email + internal RFC tomorrow morning. Meeting to finalize timeline at 1745679540 (standup slot) — ping me if you can't make it. :wave:
